verdicts.claim: all four genomes (origin, evolved, child, grandchild) become cards of at most 200,000 bytes that read back to the exact genome, and the same genome makes the same card twice
verdicts.saw: origin 196947 B round-trips, same bytes twice; evolved 196947 B round-trips, same bytes twice; child 196947 B round-trips, same bytes twice; grandchild 196947 B round-trips, same bytes twice

verdicts.claim: every one of 300 random damages to the child’s card is refused; every one-byte change to the genome in its pixels, re-wrapped with fresh checksums, is refused by the seal; every truncation is refused; and the card re-compressed by another tool still opens
verdicts.saw: 300/300 damaged cards refused; 527/527 re-wrapped forgeries refused by the seal; 5/5 truncations refused; re-compressed by another tool still opens

verdicts.claim: on the reference device the child keeps all four organs live — nothing dropped
verdicts.saw: the child carries 4 live organs, dropped none; crossed shopper, triage, water, crop

verdicts.claim: on every domain the child’s organ scores on unseen cases at least the worse parent’s (less 0.005), and on at least one domain at least the better parent’s
verdicts.saw: shopper child 0.827767 (parents 0.802782–0.815265); triage child 0.952127 (parents 0.952127–0.952127); water child 0.747656 (parents 0.747656–0.759995); crop child 0.753796 (parents 0.753796–0.762582) on unseen cases

verdicts.claim: bred on the noisy-shop device the child drops exactly its shop organ (cut) and carries three; bred on the no-water device it drops exactly its water organ (dormant) and carries three
verdicts.saw: noisy shop: dropped shopper (cut), carries 3; no water: dropped water (dormant), carries 3

verdicts.claim: the child’s card opens on device A and device B that trust its breeder — the same genome, two different organisms, each grown on its own half of the history — and is refused under a stranger’s trust list
verdicts.saw: the same genome opened on both devices: true; organisms b4ff8d8772d2631e and a74eeef6830a86c9; under a stranger’s trust list: the genome in the card was refused: untrusted maker

verdicts.claim: on both half-history devices every organ the child carries goes live
verdicts.saw: live on device A: 4, on device B: 4, of 4

verdicts.claim: the lineage holds: evolved names the origin; the child names origin and evolved, at the higher bar (0.6); the grandchild names the child and the origin, all its organs live
verdicts.saw: evolved ← origin; child ← origin + evolved at bar 0.6; grandchild ← child + origin, 4/4 live
